purpose: Teach: 最古/三振/高地/産学/海賊版/長け/ショールーム/師団

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、地域最古、つまり最古の警察署と連携されますね
lines.en: So the police coordinate with the oldest station in the area — the region's very oldest, right?
lines.style: Friendly opening, leaning in slightly. Mid-pace, with a curious lift on the final confirmation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者の証言の三振、つまり三度失敗にも、警察、対応されますね
lines.en: And even when a suspect's testimony strikes out — fails three times — you still follow up, don't you?
lines.style: Slight amused emphasis on the baseball metaphor, then a respectful, steady finish.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、高地、つまり高地での山岳救助訓練もされますね
lines.en: You run mountain-rescue training up in the highlands too — at real altitude, right?
lines.style: Mild wonder creeping in. Pace slows a touch, eyebrows-raised tone on the training detail.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、産学、つまり産学連携の科学捜査を、警察、進められますね
lines.en: And the forensic work — you're advancing that through industry-academia partnerships, aren't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful, tapping-the-notes delivery. Careful stress on the partnership term, ending on a warm note.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、海賊版DVD押収事案を、警察、捜査されますね
lines.en: You handle the pirated-DVD seizure cases as well, investigating those directly, right?
lines.style: Brisker, matter-of-fact checklist energy. A small knowing nod baked into the closing tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、武術に長けた警察官の特訓もされますね
lines.en: And there's special training for the officers skilled in martial arts, isn't there?
lines.style: Genuine admiration surfacing. Slightly quicker pace, a low appreciative note under the question.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、住民向けに防犯ショールームを開かれますね
lines.en: You even open a crime-prevention showroom for the local residents, don't you?
lines.style: Warm, almost smiling delivery. Light stress on the showroom idea, gently rising close.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、防災で師団、つまり師団規模の合同演習に参加されますね
lines.en: And for disaster response, you join joint exercises at division scale — a full division, right?
lines.style: Quiet awe on the scale of it. Slower, rounded finish that wraps the whole briefing respectfully.
